subject: Implementation playbook & integration timeslot request
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@averysystems.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Implementation playbook & next steps (post-discovery)

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the discovery session yesterday — the team found it helpful. We'd like to move to a focused technical session to align on integration patterns, networking constraints, and an implementation playbook you can deliver to our infra team.

Proposed agenda (30–45m):
- 10m: high-level integration approach and model selection
- 15m: network topology, VPC peering, and security controls
- 10m: rollout plan & responsibilities (runbook)

Availability this week:
- Thu 4/15 3:00–4:00 PM PT
- Fri 4/16 9:00–10:00 AM PT
- Mon 4/19 11:00 AM–12:00 PM PT

We can extend to 60 minutes if you think we need more time. I've attached our discovery notes for your reference (see avery-discovery-notes.pdf). Please loop in any Redwood engineers who should attend.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Solutions Architect | Avery Systems
phone: (415) 555-0198

Attachment: avery-discovery-notes.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

Hi Lena — great to hear, and thanks for sending the notes.

We can cover that agenda. Proposed times (I'll list in PT to keep it simple):
- Thu 4/15 3:00–3:45 PM PT (tight, we'd keep to 45m)
- Mon 4/19 11:00 AM–12:00 PM PT (preferable — Soojin and Ben can join for an hour)

Soojin will run through the network/topology questions and Ben will cover rollout/runbook and autoscaling/throughput expectations. If you expect a detailed topology review, let's take 60m on Mon 4/19 so we can capture a tentative runbook and action items.

Pre-reads: I've added a short agenda and a placeholder network diagram in our Drive folder (link below) — attaching a DOCX copy as well for your ops team.

A couple of asks so we can make the session effective:
- Can Avery share a VPC/network diagram or firewall rules before the call? If not, even a short list of outbound ports and subnets is helpful.
- Do you want a brief demo of the KV cache / warm-start behavior, or should we focus entirely on topology and runbook?

If Lena prefers an hour, Mon 4/19 11:00–12:00 works for the core agenda and leaves follow-ups for a separate follow-up session.

Thanks — Soojin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
